dict.string: Ledge reads the current track from Music and Spotify so it can show what's playing in the notch. It never sends this anywhere.
Ledge shows your next meeting in the notch as it approaches, with a button to join. It only reads events; it never changes or shares them.
Ledge shows your next meeting in the notch as it approaches, with a button to join. It only reads events; it never changes or shares them.
Ledge watches your Downloads folder for in-progress downloads so it can show their progress in the notch.

Ledge uses your location only to look up local weather. The coordinates are rounded to about a kilometre and go to Open-Meteo and nowhere else, and you can set a location manually in Settings instead.
